note: Three guest authors argue that AI forces the question of what mathematical work is for, and that tying a mathematician's worth to output such as publications and awards is what makes AI feel threatening. They propose 'egoless' mathematics, which does not make truth conditional on preserving our own importance, and suggest AI enthusiasts and abstainers share a common commitment to mathematical truth.
title: Egoless Mathematics in the AI Era
who: Karthik C. S., Amit Sahai and Jie Xue (guest post on Terence Tao's blog)
